newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Great Lake loading 36,000 tonnes soymeal. El Flamenco loading 40,000 tonnes soymeal. Basma loading 32,921 tonnes soymeal. Valentina loading 35,000 tonnes soymeal. Mary M. loading 35,697 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, 10 vessels to load soymeal, two to load soybeans and one for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 774 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on July 22, as well as 272 trucks with soymeal and 72 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Darya loading 50,050 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 12,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Commander loading 67,007 tonnes. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 51,000 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 61 trucks carrying 1,584 tonnes soybeans arrived on July 22.
Rail: 41 wagons arrived carrying 2,416 tonnes soybeans.
